stem: Incidence refers to which epidemiologic quantity?

options.label: A
options.text: New cases in a population over a defined period
options.misconception: None; incidence = new cases over time.
options.explanation: CDC: incidence is new cases over a specified period.

options.label: B
options.text: Only lipid A toxicity from gram-negative LPS endotoxin
options.misconception: Micro. (does not match the cited teaching point).
options.explanation: This option does not match the cited source passage for the stem.

options.label: C
options.text: Only Koplik spots counted on illness day three exams
options.misconception: Measles. (does not match the cited teaching point).
options.explanation: This option does not match the cited source passage for the stem.

options.label: D
options.text: Only capsule blockade of phagocyte ingestion events
options.misconception: Micro. (does not match the cited teaching point).
